scenes.say: How do you roll out new code without breaking things? Which deployment strategy gives you the edge?

scenes.label: Rolling
scenes.sub: Update a few servers at a time behind the load balancer.
scenes.say: Rolling updates swap out a few servers at a time, while the load balancer keeps traffic flowing.
Blue green runs two full environments and just flips the load balancer. Canary starts tiny, sending five percent of traffic to the new version, then ramps up if all looks good.
If things go wrong, rolling redeploys the old code, blue green flips back instantly, and canary just sets the new version's weight to zero.

scenes.question: Which strategy costs double capacity?
scenes.right: Blue green needs two environments, so it costs more.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: which strategy costs double the capacity? It's blue green, since you need two full environments.
